title: Claude Marketplace — Anthropic Enterprise B2B App Store
description: Anthropic launched Claude Marketplace (March 6-8, 2026) — a B2B enterprise procurement hub for Claude-powered third-party tools. Enterprises can purchase tools from partners (Replit, GitLab, Harvey, and others) against existing Anthropic spending commitments. Anthropic takes no commission. Currently in limited preview. Key characteristics: (1) Enterprise-focused, not consumer; (2) Third-party tools built on Claude, not Anthropic-native; (3) Department-specific agents and private plugin marketplaces for enterprise subscribers; (4) Reduces vendor management overhead for enterprise AI buyers. NOT a Claude Code feature — this is a Claude.ai ecosystem/business product. The existence of a marketplace signals growing ecosystem maturity and potential for discovering new Claude-powered tools.
notes: Not integrable into local claude-evolution system — this is an enterprise procurement feature for Claude.ai customers. Monitor for: (1) Whether marketplace tools expose MCP servers we could use; (2) Whether any marketplace-listed tools become independently available open-source. Expected score: 20-35 (informational only). Potentially more useful if the marketplace opens to individual Claude Max subscribers.

evaluation.reasoning: Enterprise B2B procurement product — not integrable into our local Claude Code self-improvement system. Integration complexity is 0 (there is no API, SDK, or integration path available for Max plan individual users). Capability expansion is minimal: informational awareness that marketplace-listed tools may eventually yield open MCP servers. The high community/maintenance scores from being official Anthropic are offset by zero integration path. Monitor passively; re-evaluate if marketplace opens to Max plan or if specific marketplace tools publish MCP servers.
